intro.text: A man Kaladin knew before he was enslaved, whose advice he often remembers.

items.text: At some point before Kaladin was enslaved, Durk told him he was a natural-born soldier and an artist with the spear, and advised him not to go through life hedging his bets.

personality.text: Superstitious, Durk wore a pair of lucky boots into every battle. He believed a man should commit to something fully or not at all.
